name: Creative Informatics (Data Science & AI), Ph.D.
department: Graduate School of Information Science and Technology — Department of Creative Informatics

deadline.value: November 17, 2026 at 14:00 JST for the AY2027 Doctoral Program Winter Entrance Examination (application window runs November 11-17, 2026 for October 2027 standard entry or April 2027 early entry; Summer exams run annually in June/August).
deadline.quote: Winter Entrance Examinations | Applications are accepted from Wednesday, November 11, until 14:00 on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 (JST).

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for this field (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

english_waiver.value: All IST applicants, including native English speakers and English-medium graduates, must submit an official TOEFL iBT (or Home Edition; Test Date Score only) to institution code 8445; only UTokyo IST Master's completers may be exempt.
english_waiver.quote: Even applicants who are native English speakers must submit a TOEFL score.

supervisor.value: The Department of Creative Informatics 2027 Admission Guide advises Doctoral applicants to 'make close contact with their prospective faculty advisor before the application period' and select an advisor in the Web Application System, without stating a formal acceptance-letter requirement.

funding.value: Competitive doctoral financial support at IST includes WINGS TAKUETSU RA (World-leading Innovative Graduate Study Program), Doctoral Student Special Research Assistant (IST-RA), SPRING GX, BOOST NAIS, and MEXT/UTokyo Fellowships.
funding.quote: Scholarship Information for Self-Supported Students | WINGS (World-leading Innovative Graduate Study Program), UTokyo | Doctoral Student Special Research Assitant (IST-RA) (For doctoral students only) | SPRING GX (For doctoral students only)

entry_route.value: Applicants must hold (or expect to complete) a Master's or Professional degree in Japan or a foreign equivalent (or pass individual eligibility screening with >= 2 years of post-bachelor's research or age >= 24).
entry_route.quote: Those who have obtained, or are expected to obtain by March 31, 2027, a Master’s or Professional degree at a Japanese university. | Those who have obtained, or are expected to obtain by March 31, 2027, a degree equivalent to a Master’s or Professional degree in a foreign country.

notes: Cross-departmental Data Science training is also offered via The University of Tokyo Data Science School (UTokyoDSS, https://dss.i.u-tokyo.ac.jp/), alongside AI/ML research in Computer Science and Mathematical Informatics.
